visual_findings: Scanner RGB is plausible in both but the kidney test field is strongly eosin-red and the prostate training field is sparse with detached round cells. Kidney TCGA-IZ-A6M9-01Z-00-DX1_3 has virtual DAPI bright in broad cytoplasmic-looking regions rather than the sparse independent nuclei (AUC 0.593, contrast 0.030). Prostate TCGA-V1-A8WL-01Z-00-DX1-2 has scattered virtual-DAPI spots, only partial overlap with StarDist nuclei, and AUC 0.577/contrast 0.042. CK/CD68 patterns lack measured protein validation. Both retain frozen QC failure and are excluded.
scope: Preview-scale inspection of cases 74-75 in the active 93-case CPU bundle; no test-label-guided QC threshold change.
